name: For Great Honor
summary: A Horde Warbringer asks you to bring marks from four battlegrounds. The request gathers honors from across the Horde's contests.

sections.title: Marks for the Warbringer
sections.body: A Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds asks you for marks from Alterac Valley, Arathi Basin, Warsong Gulch, and the Darkspear Islands. You bring three Marks of Honor from each place, carrying their honors to the Warbringer.

faq.q: What does the Warbringer ask for?
faq.answer: The Horde Warbringer asks for three Marks of Honor from Alterac Valley, Arathi Basin, Warsong Gulch, and the Darkspear Islands.
The Horde Warbringer is outside the battlegrounds.

faq.q: How many marks are needed from each place?
faq.answer: You bring three Marks of Honor from each of the four places.

attribution: In-game quest text: For Great Honor
